title: The Maharashtra Private Skills Universities (Establishment and Regulation) Act, 2024
full_text: The Maharashtra Private Skills Universities (Establishment and Regulation) Act, 2024 महाराष्ट्र खाजगी विद्यापीठे (स्थापना व विनियमन) अधिनियम, 2024 Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 202415 Act Number: 15 Enactment Date: 2024-08-07 Act Year: 2024 Short Title: The Maharashtra Private Skills Universities (Establishment and Regulation) Act, 2024 Hindi Title: महाराष्ट्र खाजगी विद्यापीठे (स्थापना व विनियमन) अधिनियम, 2024 Long Title: Maharashtra Private Skills Universities (Establishment and Regulation) Act, 2024 An Act to enact a law to unify, consolidate and amend the laws relating to the self-financed private skills universities in the State of Maharashtra and to provide for establishment, incorporation and regulation of self-financed private skills universities for development and advancement of skill education and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
